leadText: The Delivery of Rotom and the Girl (Japanese: 運搬！！ロトムと女の子！ Transport!! Rotom and the Girl!) is the second chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.
plainText:
The Delivery of Rotom and the Girl (Japanese: 運搬！！ロトムと女の子！ Transport!! Rotom and the Girl!) is the second chapter of the of the Pokémon Adventures manga.

==Plot==
 
==Major events==
 
The s report to Guzma about their loss to .
Guzma tells the Grunts to bring Sun to him so he can teach the boy a lesson personally.
Sun sets out to take and to Professor Kukui as part of his delivery.
Moon reveals that she is a pharmacist and a skilled archer.
Sun and Moon meet the guardian deity of Melemele Island, , who attacks them.
After a brief battle with Sun, Tapu Koko flees, leaving behind a Sparkling Stone.
Sun and Moon arrive at Professor Kukui's laboratory.
The island kahunas reveal that the guardian deities have been angered, and begin planning on how to appease them.
